deviations: Context (DJ): RA-3's row (§5 L225) names no page, so the board draws the entry gate of RA-1 (L223): SCR-149 over the Owner's SCR-010 workspace, the previous non-admin route, with gate.body 'until 14:17 UTC' (D6 L119). Boards 11-13 run entry → verifying → wrong; the held-save case (gate.body_held over SCR-122) is RA-5, board 15, with its outcomes RA-6..RA-8 on boards 16-18 (L227-230). The workspace is E10's WorkspaceCanvas as one neutral placeholder (kit app_shell), unmasked under the scrim: the gate is not a lock (L213).

gate.cancel_note is drawn (DJ; board 13 review r1 finding 1): §14 L601's 'RA-1 only' is read as the entry gate (RA-1's state, L223), whose Cancel still returns to the workspace after a failure, never RA-5's held-save gate (gate.body_held, L227), where Cancel leaves the page in place with save.not_saved_locked (RA-6, L228; D02:271). RA-3's copy-key cell (L225) lists only what the state adds (gate.title and gate.body are not listed either); D02:270 says the dialog stays on wrong credentials; board 11 draws the note on this same gate, in the same place (under the fields, above the actions). Spec question for #886: §14 L601 could say 'entry gate only', settling it for boards 12 and 13.

Buttons, chips, badges, banners, fields, tiles, tables, menus and dialogs are compositions from tokens: admin controls are 32 px (size.control.comfortable, §4 L176) while the library CMP-001 binds size.control.height (24 px in the file's compact density), and cvsheet v1 cannot set an instance's glyph, fill or border.

CMP-201's reveal toggle ('Show password'; showReveal defaults to true, 15:2346-2347) is not drawn: §5 L236's Tab order Password → code → Cancel → Unlock admin (and §13 L582) has no stop for it. Spec gap for #886: either the gate sets showReveal false or its Tab order gains the toggle.

CMP-040 FormField's gap between label, control and hint binds space.field.gap (8 px) on both fields: CMP-040's tokens are space.field.* (15:416), the density-aware field alias (16-design-system-brief.md:90), where e42kit's field() binds space.stack.xs (4 px). Kit-level (board 13 review r1 finding 3), applied to this board only; field() is unchanged, routed to the kit owner.

The focus ring round the Password well takes the build notes' name 'CMP-039 FocusRing (composition)' (15:398; components.offline.json lists 'CMP-039 · FocusRing (spec only)'), where e42kit's ring() names it 'focus-ring'. Kit-level (board 13 review r1 finding 4), applied to this board only (focus_ring()); ring() is unchanged, routed to the kit owner.

A focus ring is a 2 px color.focus.ring inner stroke on a wrapper with space.inset.xs (4 px) padding, so it sits 2 px off the control (CMP-039) inside the wrapper's bounds; its radius is the next step (radius.card around radius.control); the wrapper adds 4 px on each side to the layout.

CMP-204 is drawn as one well, as D7 words it ('one input', L120) and as the kit draws gate.code_label (k.field); CMP-204's six visually segmented cells (15:2374 'navigation between cells'; E09-D04:84-85; D02:263 '[_ _ _ _ _ _]') are the component's own look, and no source gives their geometry.

The unfocused code well sits in a stroke-less 'focus-ring slot' (space.inset.xs padding) so it lines up with the Password well inside the CMP-039 FocusRing wrapper's 4 px: both wells 424 px, both fields 432 px, the Default dialog's inner width (kit choice: no source sets a field width).

No field takes an error border or aria-invalid (DJ): 401 mfa_invalid names neither factor (Y:11234-11235), so the error is the one CMP-027 slot under the code (L225), in the anatomy's order after the code's label and hint (L212-213), not either field's error.
CMP-043 'size' Default and Large are drawn 480 and 640 px wide (kit choice): §5 L211, §9 L415 and §12 L530 name the sizes, and no source gives their widths.
The kit's dialog() note says 'the first sentence is the description'; the gate's description is the whole body, both sentences (L237; D02:271), so this board replaces the dialog's note.

TopBar, NavRail, RightRail and StatusBar content other than the Admin entry, the env badges and the owner's name, and the SCR-010 workspace under the gate, are drawn as neutral placeholders (E10-D02 owns them; §1 L97 gives only the sizes). Chrome surface (kit-level, board 06 review r1 finding 5, correcting e42kit's 'no source names a chrome surface'): `15` names one per part, color.surface.raised for CMP-071 NavRail, CMP-072 TopBar and CMP-209 RightRail (15:699, :708, :2421) and color.surface.sunken for CMP-208 StatusBar (15:2411); the kit draws all four on color.surface.app, CMP-070 AppShell's surface (15:690), with color.border.subtle dividers, as boards 01-10 do; binding `15`'s surfaces is a kit change routed to the kit owner.
Kit-level (board 06 review r1 finding 6), applied to this board only: the RightRail takes the build notes' name 'CMP-209 RightRail (composition)' (kit: 'RightRail (composition)'; 15:2416).

The annotation column prints the kit's DS-3 line verbatim and the DS-5, scrim and size.control.comfortable lines in short form, with opacity.scrim's Tier-1 WARN beside it (the sheet notes keep every kit line in full), and cites the contrast pairs as one §15 range (L637-650: L637, L639-640, L648-650), so the column fits the 1760 px root the page pitch allows.
Board names carry Penpot's normalised ' / ' form (E42-D03 / 31 SCR-121 / populated · …) so cvsheet's find-or-create root matches on every section call; §0 L46-47 writes 'SCR-121/populated'.
